work_scope: original selected Q, baseline country set empty; all eligible publication years including pre2000
doi_normalization: lower/trim; remove canonical doi.org/dx.doi.org and doi: prefix only; no approximate identifier join
country_evidence: Only explicit full-country tail in personal author affiliations; same frozen aliases as pilot v1; ambiguous or multiple country tail abstains; email tail stripped; never journal-country, references, HQ/ROR proxies

crossref.identity: exact DOI plus valid ISO7064-checksum ORCID exact match to one original Work authorship AND normalized exact source given+family (or family+given) equals that same authorship raw_author_name; only if raw name absent may original linked author display_name be used; source given/family both nonempty
crossref.fullname_without_orcid: review_only (no source title/year in organisation dump)
crossref.eligibility: at least one unambiguous direct author-country and identity-supported source assertion
crossref.unmatched_assertion_countries: never union countries from authors not independently identity-matched
crossref.profile_orcid_name_conflict: reject, never use a linked author-profile ORCID to override conflicting raw original name

pubmed.identifiers: exact original PMID or DOI; if DOI or PMID exists on both sides any conflict rejects
pubmed.title: exact Unicode lowercase letter/digit token normalization against source ArticleTitle or VernacularTitle; >=20 letter/digit characters and >=5 tokens, or >=10 CJK characters; no fuzzy/stemming
pubmed.year: at least one explicit PubMed publication year within +/-1 of original Work year; original invalid year rejects
pubmed.author: at least one valid exact ORCID, or normalized exact original full author name with >=2 tokens and >=8 letters, or >=3 CJK characters; no initial-only family match
pubmed.eligible_record: supported full Work identity and at least one unambiguous direct author country
pubmed.conflicting_multiple_records: no auto union if multiple candidate PubMed identities disagree
pubmed.updates: not applied in declared January2026 baseline-only source; never claim current complete PubMed

evidence: raw source file SHA, record/line ordinal/SHA, source author affiliations, original id/year/title/authors and decision reasons; raw originals immutable; redact emails in review derivatives
quality: source-supported country correctness distinct from all-author country-set completeness; preserve missing evidence and conflicts in denominator; gate frozen by independent validation agent
prohibited: No per DOI/PMID metadata API; no overwriting original countries/cache/statistics/production; no holdout-driven tuning followed by claiming same holdout passed
replaces: metadata-strict-v3-20261112-01 before any new holdout input/outcome revealed
